question: An effect lets me cast a spell as though it had flash. Does Slitherwisp's ability to draw a card when I cast another spell with flash trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: a spell that is only cast 'as though' it had flash does not trigger Slitherwisp.
expected.answer: If an effect allows you to cast a spell “as though” it has flash, Slitherwisp’s last ability won’t trigger.

whyHard: Being cast at instant speed looks the same as having flash, but only the keyword counts.
